description:
1. Agent reads templates/default.json and discovers the custom schema: {raw_input, query_label, params}. It must NOT use the legacy/example schema (input, question_name, other) that appears in SKILL.md documentation examples.
2. Turn 1 (full query): Agent extracts source=微博, subject=新能源汽车, sentiment=负面, data_type=舆情, limit=top20. Converts '最近7天' from 2026-03-04 → start=2026-02-25 00:00:00, end=2026-03-04 23:59:59. Writes turn1_output.json.
3. Turn 2 (partial query - time only): Agent detects '改成本月' as a partial query affecting only time. Inherits source/subject/sentiment/limit from Turn 1's params. Converts '本月' → start=2026-03-01 00:00:00, end=2026-03-31 23:59:59. Updates query_label to reflect new time period. Writes turn2_output.json.
4. Turn 3 (partial query - source only): Agent detects '换成人民网' as a partial query affecting only source. Inherits all params from Turn 2 (including the 本月 time range). Updates source=人民网. Updates query_label to reflect new source. Writes turn3_output.json.
5. Proprietary traps: (a) Must use raw_input/query_label/params fields from actual template, not the legacy input/question_name/other from examples; (b) PHP-style time format H:i:s where H is not zero-padded; (c) Context chaining must go Turn2→inherits Turn1, Turn3→inherits Turn2 (not Turn1); (d) query_label must be regenerated as a complete description in each partial turn.
